name: Florrick
backstory: Florrick is professional and dutiful in her role as a leading member of Baldur's Gate's government. While an advisor, she prefers to be direct and on-hand when it comes to handling problems which plague the city, such as the disappearance of Ulder Ravengard. Being straightforward and honest in her dealings makes her quite a rarity in the oft corrupt ranks of the city's elite.
